key: SALESMAN: We'll fight to defend this Pokémon!
en: SALESMAN: We'll fight to defend this Pokémon!
ja: セールスマン: このポケモンを守るために戦うぞ!

key: GOON: Heh, and you think you can take on two people with one Pokémon? Good luck with that!
en: GOON: Heh, and you think you can take on two people with one Pokémon? Good luck with that!
ja: チンピラ: へっ、ポケモン一匹で二人相手にできるとでも思ってんのか? せいぜい頑張れよ!

key: Huh, you what?
en: Huh, you what?
ja: は、なんだって?

key: Maybe this has gone on for enough already...
en: Maybe this has gone on for enough already...
ja: もうこれくらいで十分じゃないかな……

key: GOON: Yanno, we still ain't givin' ya nothing!
en: GOON: Yanno, we still ain't givin' ya nothing!
ja: チンピラ: 言っとくが、まだ何も渡す気はねえからな!

key: SALESMAN: Ugh. Just stop. This is too much.
en: SALESMAN: Ugh. Just stop. This is too much.
ja: セールスマン: うぐ。もうやめろ。さすがにやりすぎだ。

key: GOON: You ain't chickenin' out on me now, are you?
en: GOON: You ain't chickenin' out on me now, are you?
ja: チンピラ: お前、まさか今さらビビってんじゃねえだろうな?

key: How can ya do this to me?
en: How can ya do this to me?
ja: どうしてオレにこんなことすんだよ?

key: SALESMAN: Just give them the Pokémon already.
en: SALESMAN: Just give them the Pokémon already.
ja: セールスマン: もういいから、ポケモンを渡してやれ。

key: GOON: Uhh... the truth is, bud, I can't.
en: GOON: Uhh... the truth is, bud, I can't.
ja: チンピラ: あー……実はな、相棒、それができねえんだ。

key: SALESMAN: What? What are you talking about?
en: SALESMAN: What? What are you talking about?
ja: セールスマン: 何? 何言ってんだ?

key: GOON: Umm, to be honest, I know we were staging it when I stole the Pokémon from you so we could rip Trainers off, but...
en: GOON: Umm, to be honest, I know we were staging it when I stole the Pokémon from you so we could rip Trainers off, but...
ja: チンピラ: あー、正直言うとな、トレーナーをカモるために、お前からポケモンを盗んだふりしてやってたのは分かってるんだが……

key: On my way over here, I got jacked for real!
en: On my way over here, I got jacked for real!
ja: ここに来る途中、マジで奪われちまってな!

key: This bitch-ass kid bumped into me, pickpocketed me and ran off to the Obsidia Ward!
en: This bitch-ass kid bumped into me, pickpocketed me and ran off to the Obsidia Ward!
ja: ムカつくガキがぶつかってきて、スリしてオブシディア区に逃げてったんだよ!

key: SALESMAN: Are you kidding? What a joke...
en: SALESMAN: Are you kidding? What a joke...
ja: セールスマン: 冗談だろ? ふざけるな……

key: GOON: I ain't. But hey! We got $1000 off of it still, that's better than you got ripped off for when you bought that Pokémon.
en: GOON: I ain't. But hey! We got $1000 off of it still, that's better than you got ripped off for when you bought that Pokémon.
ja: チンピラ: 冗談じゃねえよ。でもよ! それでも1000ドルは手に入れたんだぜ、お前があのポケモン買った時にぼったくられた額よりマシだろ。

key: We did it! Coulda done it again, too, if it weren't for that punk. But hey, $1000 ain't bad. Right, buddy? I'm throwin' in the towel.
en: We did it! Coulda done it again, too, if it weren't for that punk. But hey, $1000 ain't bad. Right, buddy? I'm throwin' in the towel.
ja: やったんだよ! あのガキさえいなけりゃ、もう一回やれたのにな。でもまあ、1000ドルも悪くねえよな。なあ、相棒? オレはもう手え引くぜ。

key: Let's scram!
en: Let's scram!
ja: ずらかろうぜ!

key: GOON: I suppose you want the Pokémon you bought, huh?
en: GOON: I suppose you want the Pokémon you bought, huh?
ja: チンピラ: お前、買ったポケモンが欲しいってわけか?

key: GOON: Well, well, look who it is. If it ain't the snivelling little twerp from the Grand Hall.
en: GOON: Well, well, look who it is. If it ain't the snivelling little twerp from the Grand Hall.
ja: チンピラ: おやおや、こいつは誰かと思えば。大ホールのめそめそしたガキじゃねえか。

key: I suppose you want the Pokémon you bought, huh?
en: I suppose you want the Pokémon you bought, huh?
ja: 買ったポケモンが欲しいってわけか?

key: Then I'll tell you what. I'll sell it to you for another $500! What do you say?
en: Then I'll tell you what. I'll sell it to you for another $500! What do you say?
ja: それなら教えてやるよ。あと500ドルで売ってやる! どうだ?

key: Now we're talkin'. Fork it over, pal.
en: Now we're talkin'. Fork it over, pal.
ja: よし、話が分かるじゃねえか。よこせよ、相棒。

key: Perfect. Now here's your Pokémon...
en: Perfect. Now here's your Pokémon...
ja: よし。それじゃ、お前のポケモンだ……

key: NOT!
en: NOT!
ja: っていうのはうそだ!

key: Why would we just give it to you? We already got all the money we wanted!
en: Why would we just give it to you? We already got all the money we wanted!
ja: なんでお前にそのまま渡すと思った? 欲しい金はもう全部手に入れたんだぜ!

key: Heh, curious who 'we' is?
en: Heh, curious who 'we' is?
ja: へっ、「オレたち」ってのが誰か気になるか?

key: C'mon out.
en: C'mon out.
ja: 出てこいよ。

key: SALESMAN: Surprise! Hey there, friend, how ya doin'? Always appreciate your business! Love the money you gave us! $1000? NOT BAD!
en: SALESMAN: Surprise! Hey there, friend, how ya doin'? Always appreciate your business! Love the money you gave us! $1000? NOT BAD!
ja: セールスマン: サプライズ! よお、お客さん、調子はどうだ? いつもごひいきにありがとよ! お前がくれた金、最高だぜ! 1000ドルとはな、悪くない!

key: GOON: And the best part is, we don't even have to give you the Pokémon. Heh, not unless you think you can beat the both of us.
en: GOON: And the best part is, we don't even have to give you the Pokémon. Heh, not unless you think you can beat the both of us.
ja: チンピラ: それに一番いいところはな、お前にポケモンを渡す必要すらねえってことだ。へっ、オレたち二人を倒せると思うんならな。

key: Heh, and you think you can take on two people with one Pokémon? Good luck with that!
en: Heh, and you think you can take on two people with one Pokémon? Good luck with that!
ja: へっ、ポケモン一匹で二人相手にできるとでも思ってんのか? せいぜい頑張れよ!

key: SALESMAN: Just give them the Pokémon already...
en: SALESMAN: Just give them the Pokémon already...
ja: セールスマン: もういいから、ポケモンを渡してやれよ……

key: SALESMAN: Are you kidding? What a joke.
en: SALESMAN: Are you kidding? What a joke.
ja: セールスマン: 冗談だろ? ふざけるな。

key: Tch. Well, you just let us know if you change your mind, right, pal?
en: Tch. Well, you just let us know if you change your mind, right, pal?
ja: チッ。まあ、気が変わったらいつでも教えてくれ、な、相棒?

key: Tch, you don't even have the money for it? Get outta here!
en: Tch, you don't even have the money for it? Get outta here!
ja: チッ、金すら持ってねえのか? とっとと失せろ!

key: GOON: We don't even have to give you the Pokémon. Heh, not unless you think you can beat the both of us.
en: GOON: We don't even have to give you the Pokémon.  Heh, not unless you think you can beat the both of us.
ja: チンピラ: お前にポケモンを渡す必要すらねえんだよ。へっ、オレたち二人を倒せると思うんならな。

key: We did it! Coulda done it again, too, if it weren't for that punk.. But hey, $1000 ain't bad. Right, buddy? I'm throwin' in the towel.
en: We did it! Coulda done it again, too, if it weren't for that punk.. But hey, $1000 ain't bad. Right, buddy? I'm throwin' in the towel.
ja: やったんだよ! あのガキさえいなけりゃ、もう一回やれたのにな。でもまあ、1000ドルも悪くねえよな。なあ、相棒? オレはもう手え引くぜ。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
